goal: Allow block templates to include transactions that bring block weight or sigops exactly to limits
Prevents leaving unused capacity at the tail of a block template for miners
reviewability: Review is paused waiting on the author to address an open blocking objection
agreement: Disagreement over whether removing the buffer is worth the risk of an invalid block
Unaddressed objection: off-by-one errors risk producing invalid blocks for tiny fee gains (ajtowns)
Concept approval: template rules should match consensus so pools do not patch binaries (ismaelsadeeq)

categories.name: mining
why: P4 because the fee gains from filling exact edge-case capacity at the tail of a block are negligible
It affects only rare template boundaries where a transaction chunk hits exact limits
